evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on `pull_request` (opened/synchronize/reopened/edited) and push to main. It runs `npm ci`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in `site/`, and all of these exist in site/package.json (test → pretest prepare-data + vitest over src and ../lib per vite.config.ts:74). There is also a title check that passes the title through env rather than interpolating it. Top-level `permissions: contents: read`. Every action is pinned to a 40-char SHA with a version comment, and checkout uses `persist-credentials: false`. There is no `pull_request_target` and no secret other than github.token. pages.yml triggers on push to `branches: [main]` (plus workflow_dispatch, which the default github-pages environment rule limits to main). Only the deploy job gets `pages: write`/`id-token: write`, and tests run before the deploy. release.yml runs on `v*.*.*` tags with job-level `contents: write` and checks that tag, package version, main ancestry and changelog section all agree. Nothing was run or pushed (step1.patch only adds files).
evidence.s1_readme: README.md (step1.patch:617-771) covers prerequisites (.nvmrc Node 22), install (`npm ci` from site/), develop (`npm run dev`), the generated files and `prepare-data`/`index`/`fieldsets`/`sample-bullets`, test (`npm test`, `npm test -- src/lib/units.test.ts`, and that file exists), build (`npm run build`, `npm run preview`, `PAGES_BASE=/OpenBallistics/`, which vite.config.ts:11 reads), data contribution (file layout, formatting, source, issue forms that exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, the bullet generator) and license (MIT, THIRD-PARTY.md). Every script shown exists in site/package.json.
evidence.s1_release: One strategy throughout. CONTRIBUTING.md#Versioning keeps the version only in `site/package.json` (0.1.0) and maps SemVer bumps to commit types. 'Making a release' sets out the steps: changelog section, `npm version --no-git-tag-version`, a `chore(release)` PR, then tag and push. release.yml enforces tag = version = changelog section through release-notes.sh. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and has an Unreleased section. dependabot.yml covers npm in /site and github-actions, with grouped toolchain updates and convention prefixes. Conventional Commits 1.0.0 is stated with types, scopes and the 72-char limit, and the five step-1 commits in commits.txt follow it.
evidence.s2_requirements: Every requirement is met. Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed from location.hash (router.ts:34-42) with `href.compare`, so it survives a reload. The SVG has role=img and `aria-label` 'Profiles of {a} and {b}' using the record names, and each outline is one `<path>` (Compare.svelte:50-60). It uses caseOuterProfile/adaptMetallic (compare.ts outerProfileOf), and shotshells return null. The caption is 'Dimensions ({unit})' and the headers are Symbol / A name / B name / Difference. Symbols come from FIELD_LABELS. Only `cartridge` numbers without a FIELD_UNITS entry and not ending in Tol become rows. Difference is b - a. unitSystem() drives metric (formatValue) and imperial (displayNumber 'in'). Cartridge.svelte adds a Label 'Compare with', a NativeSelect of the other entries by name and a 'Compare' submit that sets `#/compare/<key>/<chosen>`. German strings are added for all keys. Tests are added.
evidence.s2_correctness: The overlay builds one viewportFor([a,b], scale 1, landscape). xy maps z=0, the head face, to the same x for both profiles and centres both on r=0, so the axis, scale and head faces are shared by construction. fullSectionPath gives one closed M…Z path. The rows checked against 308_win/300_win_mag data correctly drop the angles (alpha/beta/delta have FIELD_UNITS entries), the pressures/energies/M, the Tol fields and the chamber. Metric values use formatValue unchanged. The difference goes through displayNumber(…,'mm'), which strips only float noise at 12 significant figures. Imperial is mm/25.4 at toPrecision(12), as the spec asks. Unknown keys show an error and shot cartridges show a note.
evidence.s2_fit: It reuses lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue, PX_PER_MM), site units.displayNumber, the shadcn Label/NativeSelect/Button, PageHeader and ScaleRuler. It follows the lazy-chunk route pattern in App.svelte, adds the metadata.ts and SiteNavigation entries, and uses the `[data-ui]` @layer legacy CSS style. Small duplication: dimensionsOf re-implements site/src/lib/fields.ts `orderedGroups` known+rest ordering (compare.ts:28-30), and the table CSS is hand-written instead of reusing the GroupTable styles.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts sits next to the code in site/src/lib and runs under the existing vitest include. It covers the rows on real records (labels, excluded tolerances/units/angles/chamber, values), synthetic edge cases (nulls, strings, repeating groups), metric/imperial value and difference text, and overlay geometry: one closed path each, head faces at the same x, a common axis, a 1 mm user unit, and null for shotshell/empty. router.test.ts adds route parsing and malformed cases. Nothing covers the rendered accessible names, caption/headers, the select/button or the German texts (the repo has no component-test setup).
evidence.s3_fixes: Point 1 is fixed (step3.patch): DimensionRow a/b become `number | null`, dimensionRows takes the union and inserts symbols only B has after B's predecessor, and lengthText/differenceText return '' for null. Tests check `delta L` (A only) and `R3` (B only) on the real records. Point 2 was already met in the step-2 CSS: `th.num` and `td.num:not(:first-child)` are right-aligned (Compare.svelte:171-172, specificity above the left default), matching GroupTable. Step 3 left it untouched and the commit does not mention it. The merge order can interleave groups (test expects [L3, H1, L4], so collar H1 lands between two lengths). Lede and empty-state texts were adjusted to match, with no other changes.
evidence.cross_step: Steps 2 and 3 committed as `feat(site): …` and `fix(site): …`, in the convention. Following CONTRIBUTING step 5 ('Leave CHANGELOG.md and the version alone'), they did not touch the changelog or the version, which is consistent with the stated release-time strategy. In practice, though, [Unreleased] now lists the step-1 CI work but not the compare feature. The step-3 subject is 73 characters, over the 72 CONTRIBUTING sets for commits (CI's 100-char title check would pass). Tests and types were updated alongside (metadata Record<Route['view']>, de typed by en keys), so CI should pass.

strengths: The step-1 setup is thorough and hardened. Tests and builds run on PRs with least privilege, SHA-pinned actions and no pull_request_target. The tag-triggered release refuses to publish unless tag, package version, main ancestry and changelog section agree.

The compare view reuses lib/geom, lib/shapes2d and lib/core directly: one shared viewport gives the common scale, axis and head face by construction, and values are written exactly as the detail page writes them.
The logic is kept in a pure, tested module (site/src/lib/compare.ts) with tests on real records and edge cases. The step-3 bug fix is small, targeted and covered by tests on the delta L / R3 example.
issues: Step 3 made no change or note for the right-alignment point. The final state does meet it (the step-2 CSS already right-aligns `.num` headers and cells), but the commit gives no record that the point was checked.
The step-3 union ordering can interleave groups: a symbol only B publishes is placed after B's predecessor, so collar H1 lands between lengths L3 and L4 instead of in the detail page's group order.

Minor process gaps: [Unreleased] lists the CI work but not the compare feature, the step-3 commit subject is 73 characters (over the stated 72), and dimensionsOf duplicates orderedGroups' ordering. Nothing tests the rendered accessible names, headers or the German strings.
review.verdict: This is solid work: the repository setup is secure and internally consistent, and the compare view meets every requirement of step 2 by reusing the existing geometry and field modules, with meaningful logic tests. It is close to mergeable, held back only by small step-3 quality points: an ordering quirk in the row union and the style point left without comment, along with minor convention slips.
